# aria

> RAG knowledge assistant — the retrieval plane of the agentic stack, backing the Creando Tu Matrix agent offers. FastAPI + LangChain + ChromaDB, API-key auth, rate limits, metrics.

aria is maintained by Adventure Wave Labs (The lab for agentic developer tooling).

## Links

- [Landing page](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/aria/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Source code](https://github.com/adventurewave-labs/aria): README, issues, releases
